items.name: The operator starts a run, and it performs the cycle's effects up to the score
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: A green HTTP candidate served the marker; R-1 passed, with the eleven specified effects in order, all recorded, including gate-attempt-passed. Both fixture items received judge scores.

items.name: A run identity is started once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 failed its fence self-check, a second start of R-1 for C-2 returned run-already-started; run-progress listed R-1 once with C-1.

items.name: A second run is refused while the first is running
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: With R-1’s builder sleeping, start-run for R-2 was refused run-in-progress; R-2 progress was null and R-1 progress was running.

items.name: A cycle is run once
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: After R-1 passed, starting R-2 for the same C-1 returned cycle-already-run, and R-2 progress was null.

items.name: A run of something that is not a commit of the project repository is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: Started R-1 against an empty Git repository with the nonexistent deadbeef commit; start-run returned not-a-commit, and run-progress returned null. No builder was configured or launched.

items.name: A checklist Measurement refuses halts the run with Measurement's refusal
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With a scenario-free plan, checklist was refused empty-checklist and the run halted before self-check and fence.

items.name: A plan whose item identities a fresh stamp does not give back halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: A plan with one untagged scenario produced two stamp events and halted at stamp for differing identities, before pin or checklist.

items.name: A failing self-check fails the cycle at the fence, and the run with it
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The self-check exited 1 with golden checklist differs; the run failed at fence for harness-self-check-failed with that detail, with no fence or regenerate.

items.name: A check the self-check skips is recorded as a listed skip
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: A passing self-check printed SKIP bb-tools; its first effect recorded harness-self-check-passed with bb-tools in skipped-checks and detail.

items.name: A fenced path that matches nothing fails the cycle at the fence
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: With harness/cycles absent, fence was refused fenced-path-matched-nothing, fail-cycle recorded fence-refused, and no builder launched.

items.name: The fresh builder sees the clean room of one commit with no fenced path
items.rule: The fence builds the clean room of the cut and proves it, as legacy fence.sh does
items.evidence: The builder recorded one clean-room commit, the plan and configuration, no candidate scope or fenced paths in its tree and reachable objects, and the provided-runtime gitlink retained mode 160000 and the cut’s object ID.

items.name: Each regenerate runs one builder session and waits for it
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The red then green candidates caused two builder launches with distinct session IDs; the log shows the first ended before the second started.

items.name: A builder that exits non-zero but leaves a candidate is gated
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder wrote a candidate then exited 1; regenerate recorded its digest and the cycle gated it and passed.

items.name: A builder that leaves nothing fails the cycle at regenerate
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The builder exited without writing a candidate; no regenerate effect was recorded, fail-cycle was recorded, and the cycle failed at regenerate for candidate-not-regenerated.

items.name: A builder that outlives the regenerate timeout is stopped and the cycle fails for its budget
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: The 30-second builder was sampled running under a 2-second regenerate budget; its recorded process and child were absent after normal shutdown, and Grain recorded a regenerate-stage budget failure.

items.name: Something answering on the port is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A pre-existing HTTP server caused three seam-answered-before-boot gate refusals, each followed by gate-refusal; the cycle failed for infrastructure and the candidate boot marker was absent.

items.name: A red suite fails the attempt before the candidate is booted
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With one attempt allowed, the red suite recorded suite-red, the boot marker was absent, and the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted.

items.name: A candidate with no launch entrypoint fails the attempt for a missing contract
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The builder produced an executable test.sh but no start.sh with one gate attempt allowed; the gate recorded gate-attempt-failed for contract-missing.

items.name: A served page without the marker fails the attempt for its identity
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: With one attempt allowed, the green candidate served hello while the configured marker was sauna; the gate recorded identity-probe-failed.

items.name: What a builder writes after it ended does not reach the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: A background writer changed the builder-room suite after the builder returned; the gate copy still passed and its install digest matched regenerate’s digest.

items.name: A repair builder sees the previous candidate and the gate evidence, read-only
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: Repair recorded verification-repair and named attempt 1’s evidence root; its builder saw the clean room, previous-candidate and gate-evidence, and write attempts to both mounted directories were blocked.

items.name: Three failed attempts fail the cycle, no fourth builder is launched, and nothing is graded
items.rule: A failed gate attempt is repaired by a fresh builder that sees only the previous candidate and the gate's evidence
items.evidence: A builder that always produced a red suite was launched three times; the cycle failed at gate for gate-attempts-exhausted, with no file-verdicts effect and only the render model request.

items.name: An item the judge did not score is Measurement's to record as unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The shared researcher code branched on the item and failed for 01-002; file-verdicts contained only 01-001, and the passed cycle’s measurement recorded 01-002 unreached with one pass of two.

items.name: A run that ended stays as it ended
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: R-1 failed its fence self-check and R-2 halted at empty-checklist; each progress reading five seconds later was identical to its first reading, including effect results.

items.name: Reading a run's progress changes nothing
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: After the run passed, two successive run-progress requests returned identical results, each showing the run passed.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the served URL, and passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The probe accepted only one argument, the configured HTTP URL, and checked its marker; the gate and cycle passed.

items.name: A candidate whose suite writes inside its own directory passes the gate
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The candidate suite created and removed a directory inside its own scope; the gate passed and install and regenerate recorded the same candidate digest.

items.name: A skipped check is recorded with the whole text after SKIP
items.rule: No clean room is built over a failed harness self-check
items.evidence: The passing self-check printed the legacy SKIP line; its effect recorded harness-self-check-passed and the full text after SKIP in skipped-checks.

items.name: A stdio candidate whose suite, identity probe and store check pass passes the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio suite, probe and store check passed; the gate event recorded 30 seconds, one poll answered on poll 1, and answered as the context, with no gate refusal and a passed cycle.

items.name: The identity probe is handed the gate room's launch entrypoint, the boot budget and the gate's store, and the store check reads that store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The stdio probe received the absolute gate-room start.sh path and 30, plus GATE_STORE outside the gate room and no LOYLY_ environment variables; the store check received that same path.

items.name: A red stdio suite fails the attempt before the identity probe, and the suite is handed no store
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The red stdio suite recorded suite-red; its captured environment contained neither LOYLY_ variables nor GATE_STORE, and probe and store-check marker files were absent.

items.name: An identity probe that fails fails the attempt for its identity, and the store is not checked
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: The failing probe’s output was recorded as identity-probe-failed detail; the store-check marker was absent.

items.name: A store check that fails fails the attempt for its identity, with the store check's output as the detail
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A passing stdio suite and probe followed by a failing store check produced gate-attempt-failed for identity-probe-failed with the store check’s FAIL event 7 output as detail.

items.name: A stdio candidate reads the spec beside it in the gate room
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: A stdio suite required plan/01-foo/spec.feature in its working directory; the gate passed and install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A stdio run whose store check cannot be started halts at the gate
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: With a green stdio candidate and no store-check command, progress showed a gate halt for effect-could-not-run and no recorded gate effect.

items.name: The harness digest of a stdio run covers the store-check command
items.rule: A stdio candidate is gated as harness/v2/gate.sh gates it: its suite, its identity probe, then the store the probe's candidate wrote
items.evidence: Two stdio runs with store-check command arguments one and two each recorded a passing first self-check, with different harness digests.

items.name: A slice that is a symbolic link in the plan is read at its target
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: The symlinked slice stamped both items and reached the checklist, but their source paths were spec/a/slice/spec.feature rather than paths under the 01-foo plan link.

items.name: The configuration's plan slices select what is stamped and checklisted
items.rule: The runner stamps, pins and derives the checklist, on the one store
items.evidence: With slices 01 and 02 and PLAN_SLICES=02, only 02-001 was stamped and the checklist contained only 02-001.

items.name: Each builder is handed the configured builder image, and each regenerate names the image and its digest
items.rule: A regenerate runs one fresh builder session and records what it left in its candidate scope
items.evidence: Both fresh and repair launches received the configured image as their third argument, and both effect details named builder-clojure and its SHA-256 digest.

items.name: A start whose configured builder image is not in the builder images directory is refused
items.rule: A run starts once, one at a time, on a commit of the project repository
items.evidence: With builder-clojure configured but absent from the builder images directory, start-run refused builder-image-missing, progress returned null, and no builder launch was recorded.

items.name: Two runs on one store compare the second cycle with the first
items.rule: Measurement keeps its history across runs on the one store, so a scoreboard compares a cycle with the last measured cycle of its selection
items.evidence: Two runs on one store completed; C-2’s scoreboard named C-1 as its previous cycle, and R-2’s recorded stamp produced no new identity and did not halt.

items.name: An identity probe that reads a file beside it in the cut passes a candidate that serves the marker
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The cut probe read its sibling config.sh and verified the served marker; the gate passed and install and regenerate digests matched.

items.name: A gate command that exits 0 passes the attempt with the budget, the poll and the probe line it printed
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command ran once in the project repo with the gate tree, candidate copy and empty evidence directory; the event recorded the printed budget, poll and probe line, and the candidate boot marker was absent.

items.name: A gate command that exits 1 naming a reason fails the attempt with that reason, and the repair builder is handed its evidence
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Attempt 1 recorded suite-red with detail 3 of 65 tests failed; the repair room contained the command’s receipt in read-only gate evidence, and attempt 2 passed.

items.name: A gate command whose last line is a refusal to grade is a gate refusal, and three in a row fail the cycle
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: A gate command returned seam-answered-before-boot on each call; three gate refusals were each followed by gate-refusal, and the cycle failed at gate for infrastructure.

items.name: A gate command whose last line names no code the runner reads halts the run at the gate
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: The command exited 2 with an unrecognized infrastructure line; progress halted at gate with that detail, no gate or fail-cycle effect, and no cycle.

items.name: The harness digest covers the gate command, and is unchanged when none is handed in
items.rule: A gate command handed in is the gate: the runner hands it the cut's tree, the candidate's copy and an evidence directory, and records its result
items.evidence: Three runs with no gate command, gate-a and gate-b recorded distinct harness digests; the no-command digest equaled SHA-256 of configuration bytes, self-check command text and probe bytes in order.

items.name: Each effect a run records lies inside the leaf of the tree named for that effect
items.rule: The run is one ORC tree, cycle.v1, and each effect the runner performs is a leaf of its own
items.evidence: The run passed, and Grain event timestamps placed each of its eleven effect results between the start and completion of its same-named leaf in the run or its delegated gate-attempt tick.

items.name: A candidate that refuses its first three requests is answered on a later poll, its margin 20 less that poll
items.rule: The gate grades a copy of the candidate on the host, in legacy verify.sh's order
items.evidence: The server rejected its first three requests; the gate passed with a 10-second, 20-poll budget and answered on poll 5, and attempt 1 recorded margin 15.

items.name: Each gate attempt runs as a child tick of its own of the workflow "cycle-runner/gate-attempt.v1"
items.rule: A gate attempt is one subtree, delegated once per attempt
items.evidence: The second attempt passed; Grain showed distinct gate-attempt.v1 child ticks containing each attempt’s install, self-check and gate leaves, with attempt 2’s repair inside attempt 1’s tick.

items.name: A copy of the candidate in a folder of its own, with no spec around it, runs a cycle
items.rule: The runner carries its own event model, as its room gave it
items.evidence: A candidate copy launched from a temporary folder outside any .pi tree completed the cycle and recorded gate-attempt-passed; the temporary folder was removed after profiling.

items.name: The judge scores each item in a child tick of its own, the scores are filed as scored, and the run passes as its cycle passes
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The measurement recorded 1 of 2 passing with booked and no receipt; Grain held scores 1.0 and 0.0 under the two checklist judge names, in distinct grade.v1 child ticks of the run, which passed.

items.name: Each item's grading starts with no other item's evidence
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The researcher branched on the input item and produced E-ONE for 01-001 and E-TWO for 01-002; the first judge request held E-ONE, while neither 01-002 researcher nor judge request held it.

items.name: The researcher is given the item, the seam and the event model, and a shell in the grading room only
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The first researcher request exposed only the item’s key names, not the scenario or the seam and event-model text required in that request. Its shell did report Linux and a grading room containing config.sh, impl, plan and probe.sh, with only that room visible in its parent.

items.name: A judge reply with the level of a pass and no reasoning scores nothing, and the item is filed unreached
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: The second judge received a level and feedback without reasoning; only 01-001 had a score in progress and Grain, and measurement filed 01-002 unreached with one pass of two.

items.name: A sealed grader whose digest the run did not approve halts the run before the cycle
items.rule: A run grades only with the approved sealed grader
items.evidence: With an unapproved rubric digest, the run halted at grader and named the actual digest, before self-check, fence or builder.

items.name: No item scored fails the score stage, and the run fails with its cycle
items.rule: The judge grades each item of the gated candidate, its scores are filed as scored, and the run ends as its cycle ends
items.evidence: Every researcher request failed; file-verdicts was refused zero-verdicts, fail-score-stage was recorded, and the cycle failed at score for score-stage-failed without another builder launch.

items.name: A runner stopped while a builder session runs resumes the run, and the session with it
items.rule: A run stopped with its runner resumes where it stopped
items.evidence: After the runner and sleeping builder were stopped and the same store reopened, the run resumed and passed; the builder logged the identical session ID twice, and progress showed one each of stamp, pin, checklist, first self-check, fence and regenerate.

items.name: The builder's instruction is the rendered text, and the repair's adds only the closing paragraph
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The first captured instruction was exactly INSTRUCTION-7; the repair instruction added only a closing paragraph naming previous-candidate and gate-evidence paths.

items.name: A render the model does not reply to halts the run before any builder
items.rule: The builder instruction is rendered by the model, and the builder is handed nothing more
items.evidence: The model returned HTTP 400 for render; progress halted at render for effect-could-not-run, with no regenerate, builder launch, fail-cycle, or concluded cycle.

items.name: Reading a running run shows its tick and the leaves it completed
items.rule: A run that cannot perform an effect halts, loudly, and a run that ended stays as it ended
items.evidence: While the builder slept, run-progress showed R-1 running with its tick identity, completed fence and render nodes, and regenerate marked running.
